# Image Redactor

Image Redactor is a browser-based image privacy tool for hiding visible sensitive areas before sharing screenshots, photos, documents, or product images.

Canonical URL: https://redact.imageprivacy.org/

## Features

- Draw redaction rectangles directly on an image
- Use solid, blur, or pixelated redaction styles
- Export a PNG copy from the browser
- Process files locally without upload

## Privacy model

The selected image is decoded and edited in the browser using canvas. Exporting creates a new copy and removes most embedded metadata from the exported file.
